title: Environmental Postgres retirement — backfill, cut over, drop
runbook_section: LIVE / Environmental Postgres retirement (2026-09-04 second grill)

supersedes.postgres_shrink_ingest_repoint_20260825:: The PostgreSQL retirement scope moves here in full, with the expanded 2026-09-04 charter (feed and social features only) and the per-layer drop gate.

note: Owner direction 2026-09-04: PostgreSQL keeps feed and social features only. Refined by the same-night second grill into four settled decisions (D1 per-layer drop on a three-part proof, D2 parity-with-Postgres backfill bar, D3 manifest-trust availability bootstrap, D4 full cutover scope). The time-slider startup cost dies at A4.
production_authorization: Agents prepare, dry-run and record every production action. Railway variable edits, --apply operator verbs, pg_dump archival and every Alembic migration against production are owner-confirmed before they fire. Retirement of an individual relation no longer waits for the global GREEN acceptance verdict, but does require its complete three-part packet.

partitions.note: Derived from the RUNBOOK key-files list and a directory read of pipeline/direct, jobs and sql/agent at this commit. The per-layer owns lists under pipeline/direct/<layer>/ are predicted paths — six of the eight directories do not exist yet. Re-verify with a real grep before any agent claims a boundary.

lanes.note: One agent per layer. Existing siblings climate/ and soil/ are the shape to copy; fire_detections.py and water_gauges.py are single-module examples.

shared_writes: pipeline/parquet/lane_registry.py, execution/job_executor_service.py (LANE_SPECS) and interface/cli/data.py are serialized registries with exactly one owner at a time. A join agent lands every registration after the layer work is reviewed; no B-lane agent edits them.
The quality receipt (QUALITY_RECEIPT.json) is rewritten by exactly one sweep at the end of a wave, never by a lane agent.
conductor/RUNBOOK.md is shared with concurrent sessions: append a named section, never rewrite the header, never git add conductor/ wholesale.
tripwires: No relation is dropped without its three-part packet; a missing archived pg_dump is a hard stop.
A parity comparison that under-covers is a blocker, never waived by a note.
A manifest-trusted availability row is labelled as such; never emit a digest not computed from the object it describes.
Railway variable edits, --apply operator verbs and production migrations are owner-confirmed.
Restart Martin after any tile migration; a missing tile function 404s the whole composite.
Never run PlantGeo locally (next dev/build, docker). Prod DSN and live Martin only.
Implementation agents run no tests; a separate reviewer context runs the single end-of-wave sweep.
